tunables.label: Server Port
tunables.troubleshooting: Platform Java base image listens on unprivileged port 8080 (server.port=8080 for Spring Boot).

tunables.label: JVM Container Flags
tunables.description: Standard container-aware JVM flags controlling heap allocation.
tunables.troubleshooting: Allows JVM to automatically adapt heap memory limits to cgroup Kubernetes resource limits.

tunables.label: Additional Java Options
tunables.description: Extra arguments passed to the java binary execution.
tunables.troubleshooting: Use for custom GC tuning (-XX:+UseG1GC) or system property definitions (-Dspring.profiles.active=prod).
